intro.lede: Explore mapped street parking, paid zones and planned events around your destination.
footer.tagline: Designed for getting there, not circling the block.
footer.notice: Data guidance only · Always follow local signs
search.title: Where are you going?
search.subtitle: Choose a destination in Berlin to see the streets around it.
search.hint: Enter at least 3 characters, then select a suggestion to confirm the location.
search.submitError: Select a Berlin address suggestion before continuing.
search.radiusLegend: How far are you willing to walk?
search.suggestEmpty: No Berlin addresses found. Try a street and house number.
search.suggestReady: {count} Berlin addresses found. Use the arrow keys to choose one.
context.title: Know what’s nearby.
context.body: Official Berlin data can show parking infrastructure and street restrictions. It can’t tell us which spaces are free right now.
context.heading: WHAT WE LOOK AT
context.foot: Built around Berlin’s open geodata · Updated as source data allows
results.title: Mapped street parking
results.empty: No mapped parking areas were returned for this radius.
results.sourceNote: Mapped capacity and restrictions from Berlin Open Data. This inventory is not live availability.
assessment.note: Estimate from mapped supply — not live occupancy. Unrestricted {usable} · conditional {conditional} · restricted {restricted}. Documented bands: <400 scarce · 400–1200 moderate · >1200 ample.
streets.title: Nearby streets
streets.empty: No eligible street candidates in this radius — nearby areas are all restricted or unmapped.
streets.note: Best and backup areas are distinct nearby streets, excluding restricted/prohibited areas.
zones.title: Parking management zones
zones.empty: No managed parking zone intersects this search area.
zones.sourceNote: Zone details are guidance; fees and hours can vary locally. Follow signs on site.
events.title: Planned street events
events.empty: No matching approved or ongoing events were returned.
events.sourceNote: This feed covers approved and ongoing events starting within the next 14 days; it may not include every disruption. An empty list does not confirm that streets are clear.
